text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby... the race that
decides the
top classic-year runner.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's every Umamusume's dream to earn
the title of
Derby champion.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And today, in front of everybody, I'm
going to
prove myself!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
They'll never see me the same way
again!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hey, way to kill the mood.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Can't you see I'm at peak hype levels
right now?
Don't make me lose it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You can't overturn your reputation all at once.

text_block_list.text:
What? But if the Derby can't change it,
then what
can?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Don't you have anything better to say?
You're
supposed to be my trainer—we
talked about this
already, remember?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: You do want to be known as a Derby trainer, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Then you need to say something to get
me extra
pumped! Go on!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Go give it your all and be yourself!

text_block_list.text: Of course I will! Next time I talk to you...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I won't be City the model, but City the
Derby
champion!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
